messages:
Liam (FinLedger): Hey team — we're finalizing a bespoke SIG/CAIQ and the audit log export is failing when we try to attach evidence. Console shows 'Export failed: 429 rate limit' and the zip is empty. Deadline EOD Thurs. Can we get repro steps and, if needed, temp creds to pull logs directly?

Maya (Customer Success): Sorry you're hitting that. Can you paste the exact error text + timestamp? Also did you use the Console export UI or the /v1/exports API?

Liam (FinLedger): Console. Filters: service=redwood.inference, timeframe=last90days, keystore=customer/kms/finledger, include=hsm-attestation. Error screenshot reads: '429 Too Many Requests — Export queue overloaded'. Occurred at 2025-02-10T15:14:03Z.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Thanks — quick context: exports are async jobs that page S3. Very large keystore histories can hit our per-customer backpressure and trigger rate limits to protect SLOs. Can you try the API to get the request-id and headers? Repro curl: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports?service=redwood.inference&keystore=customer/kms/finledger&start=2025-01-01&end=2025-02-10" -o out.json
```

Liam (FinLedger): Ran the curl — got a 429 with header `Retry-After: 30` and response contained partial metadata then stalled. Request-Id header: req_0a7b3c2d.

Eve (Eng SRE): I'll pick this up. Can you paste the request-id (got it) and full response headers if possible? @export-bot can you surface job queue depth for keystore-export for finledger?

export-bot: Job queue depth for keystore-export: finledger=92, system threshold=80, current worker count=4.

Devon (Security): For the SIG you can provide interim evidence while we unblock the export: a signed SHA256 manifest of keys + rotation timestamps and the existing HSM attestation PDF. I can prepare a bespoke cover letter tying those artifacts to the audit log. That said we still need raw audit samples for the assessor. If export is blocked we can do an ad-hoc log dump and sign it.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Workarounds: 1) request shorter window exports (7-day slices) which reduce pagination and backpressure; 2) we can create a short-lived service account with read-only export scope and hand creds to the customer to pull directly; 3) temporarily scale workers. Which do you prefer?

Liam (FinLedger): Short-window slices sound good if we can do a few representative ranges. Also if you can provide a temp service account that would let our security team upload directly to the SIG portal.

Maya (Customer Success): I'll request a temporary service account and escalate ops. Liam — do you want us to upload the artifacts to their portal or provide a pre-signed S3 link you can download?

Eve (Eng SRE): Ops update: created sacct export-reader-finledger-20250210, expires 2025-02-10T18:00:00Z. Credentials sent via encrypted support ticket. Bumped workers from 4 -> 8 and started draining backlog; job queue now 35.

export-bot: Job updated: finledger=35, workers=8, recent exports successful=3/3.

Liam (FinLedger): Received creds via ticket, running a 7-day export for 2025-01-31 -> 2025-02-06 now. If that completes I'll attach to the questionnaire. Thanks everyone :pray: 

Devon (Security): I'll draft the cover letter with KMS key lineage, rotation stamps, and HSM attestation. Also can produce a PGP-signed SHA256 manifest if the assessor prefers.

Maya (Customer Success): Customer accepts signed PDF + SHA256 manifest. I'll confirm final upload details after the export completes. :thumbsup:

Eve (Eng SRE): Follow-up: we also added a short-term rate-limit exemption for the export job (finledger) for the next 3 hours to avoid further 429s while you finish the questionnaire. Will monitor and revert.

Liam (FinLedger): Export finished and archive contains the log slices and KMS rotation records. Attaching to the SIG now. Big help, appreciate the quick turnaround!
